# CheckNumber WhatsApp Number Checker API
> Official integration examples for the CheckNumber asynchronous WhatsApp API product family.

## Canonical resources
- [Product page](https://checknumber.ai/products/whatsapp): Registration, activity, and profile-signal products.
- [Registration API documentation](https://docs.checknumber.ai/whatsapp-bulk-checker): Canonical `ws` contract.
- [Activity API documentation](https://docs.checknumber.ai/whatsapp-activity-checker): Canonical `ws_active` contract.
- [Profile API documentation](https://docs.checknumber.ai/whatsapp-bulk-number-checker-avatar): Canonical `ws_avatar` contract.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/checkernumber/whatsapp-number-checker-api): Official multi-language examples and OpenAPI contract.
- [Dashboard](https://platform.checknumber.ai): Account registration and API-key management.
- [Pricing](https://checknumber.ai/pricing): Current product pricing and limits.

## Product facts
- Brand: CheckNumber.
- API base URL: https://api.checknumber.ai.
- Authentication: X-API-Key request header.
- Input: text file with one E.164 phone number per line.
- Processing: asynchronous bulk task.
- Products: ws, ws_active, ws_avatar.
- Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Shell.

## Product contracts
- `ws`: 500–10,000,000 rows; fields `number`, `activated`.
- `ws_active`: 1,000–10,000,000 rows; fields `number`, `activated`, `activetime`, `activedays`, `business`. The retired `signature` field is not returned.
- `ws_avatar`: 500–10,000,000 rows; fields `number`, `activated`, `age`, `avatar`, `category`, `gender`, `hair_color`, `skin_color`. The export uses one canonical `number` column.

## Integration workflow
1. Send multipart `POST /v1/tasks` with `file` and `task_type`.
2. Send multipart `POST /v1/gettasks` with `task_id` until `status=exported` or `failed`.
3. Download `result_url` only after export.
4. Use `GET /v1/balance` to retrieve the current account balance.

## Security and usage
- Read the API key from the `CHECKNUMBER_API_KEY` environment variable.
- Never expose an API key in production browser code.
- Process only phone numbers you are authorized to verify.
- The sample code is MIT licensed; the API service and product content are governed by their respective terms.
